messages:
jordan: Heads up — main CI turned red immediately after the merge from @sam. Smoke suite failing, looks like kvalloc and grpc smoke. CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/2461122334 (failed step: smoke-tests). Anyone available to take first look?

deploy-bot: pipeline failed · step=smoke-tests · exit_code=1 · failed_tests=[kvalloc_test::AllocRace, grpc_integration::smoke_connect] (logs attached)
maria: On it, pulling the logs now.
jordan: Can someone kick a rerun while we eyeball logs? @oncall-sre? quick check to see if this is flaky or deterministic.
oncall-sre: Rerun started: https://ci.redwood.internal/2461122400 · will update in a few mins. FYI saw a kvalloc flake reported yesterday around 03:20 UTC.
tim: I can start a bisect if rerun flakes. @sam did your change touch any alloc path or grpc infra?
sam: My PR only bumped a test timeout (smoke timeout 60s -> 90s) and docs. No code changes to alloc or grpc.
jordan: Hmm timeout tweak could affect scheduling windows for the smoke runner. Quick log snapshot: ```[error] kvalloc_test::AllocRace FAILED — AssertionError: allocation failed: out of memory while allocating 268435456 bytes on GPU0
stack: /srv/runtime/alloc.cpp:421
  at free_list::pop()
  at kvalloc::alloc()```
maria: Rerun finished and failed again, same failure in kvalloc_test::AllocRace. Short log: ```AllocRace: tried 12 allocations, failed at iteration 7, OOM```
tim: I'm taking bisect now — bisecting commits between last-green=2461121000 and 2461122334. If bisect narrows to sam's PR, recommend revert. If bisect is inconclusive, we'll try reverting the timeout change in CI first.
sam: If revert is needed I can open a revert PR ASAP. Sorry folks, will stand by. :grimacing: 
oncall-sre: Marking thread as urgent for oncall rotation. If bisect takes long, we should consider temporary pin to previous working build for deploys.
jordan: Agreed. Tim — ping once you have a culprit commit. If reruns keep failing, let's revert within 30m to minimize cascading failures. Thanks all. :eyes:
